name: hxcpp
description: SeiunEngine fork: official hxcpp v4.3.175 rebased onto upstream master, with zlib-ng 2.3.90 compression, upstream PR #1357 weak-key Hash ephemeron marking, the #1409 HXCPP_GC_BIG_BLOCKS row-count fix, per-call haxe.zip stream counters, and the SeiunEngine bilingual build progress UI.
releasenote: Rebased the fork from official hxcpp 4.3.2 (27210f21) onto v4.3.175 (e6387333), dropping fork patches that upstream has superseded and re-porting the rest. See docs/seiunengine-rebase-4.3.175.md.
